question: Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended Mauritius National Day as the chief guest on March 12. What is the capital of Mauritius?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Port Louis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi to attend Mauritius National Day as chief guest on March 12.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** was on a **two-day state visit to Mauritius** starting **March 11, 2025**.
 
• He was invited as the **Chief Guest** for the **National Day celebrations** of Mauritius, which are held every year on **March 12**.
 
• The **National Day of Mauritius** commemorates the country's **independence from British rule on March 12, 1968**.
 
• **Prime Minister Modi a**ttended Mauritius' National Day celebrations as Chief Guest for the **second time since 2015**.
 
• The visit saw participation from various Indian Defence Forces, including a **contingent of Indian Defence Forces**, an **Indian Navy ship**, and the **Indian Air Force Akash Ganga sky diving contingent**.
 
• **Mauritius** is an island nation in the **Indian Ocean**, located about **2,000 kilometers off the southeastern coast of Africa**. Its capital is **Port Louis**.
